claim_boundary: One-case prefix-only competence control on the already-open single_lift_cloth source interaction. It cannot establish Bayesian-PhysTwin improvement, calibration, independent transfer, or state of the art.
question: Can frozen causal TAPNext++ tracks, conservatively lifted through released calibrated RGB-D views, recover benchmark material identities accurately enough to justify a separately locked guarded Bayesian assimilation smoke?

window_selection.source: released selected PhysTwin node trajectory only; no manual material target was used
window_selection.rule: Among all 20-frame intervals wholly inside the released training prefix, maximize RMS physical-node displacement from the first to the last included frame.

tracker.name: TAPNext++
tracker.runtime_choices: Official 512-pixel public checkpoint; recurrent frame-by-frame causal inference; 64 official-style local support points per real query at 32 model pixels; seed 72; deterministic cuDNN; continuous visibility logits retained.

multiview_observation.point_estimate: Robust DLT triangulation from two or three depth-consistent object-mask-supported views.
multiview_observation.prior_reliability: TAPNext++ visibility, object-mask support, reprojection agreement, and RGB-D depth agreement only.
multiview_observation.correlation_treatment: A 5 mm shared-bias covariance floor is applied once, two-view estimates receive fourfold geometric covariance inflation, and alternative association spread is added to metric covariance.
multiview_observation.fallback: Unsupported rows retain the exact query position and zero update support.

source_artifacts.query_source: Only benchmark identities 3, 4, 6, and 8 at source frame 68.
source_artifacts.withheld_source: Manual identity trajectories on frames [68, 88), inaccessible to prediction and opened only after prediction sealing.

competence_gate.pass_action: Freeze a separate baseline-relative guarded assimilation method before reading any PhysTwin future score.
competence_gate.fail_action: Stop the TAPNext++-to-PhysTwin route without tuning tracker, camera, mask, depth, multiview, visibility, anchoring, or gate choices.

forbidden: running prediction before source artifact hashes and locked status replace every prelock placeholder
using any RGB, depth, mask, manual track, point cloud, or simulator outcome outside the frozen prefix
changing tracker, checkpoint, support points, cameras, masks, depth checks, triangulation, covariance, visibility, identities, or gates after prediction
using a PhysTwin residual to define prior perception reliability
describing a competence pass as Bayesian-PhysTwin improvement or state-of-the-art evidence
opening or modifying any held-v8 target, query, score, barrier, or outcome artifact
